title: The Value of Being Wrong: Self-Mined Visual In-Context Learning from Errors
abstract: arXiv:2610.16977v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual in-context learning (ICL) enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt at test time via demonstration examples, but its effectiveness depends critically on the examples selected. Recent counterfactual selection methods improve ICL by constructing demonstrations that expose how individual attribute changes affect the answer. However, they require multi-stage pipelines involving attribute extraction, caption engineering, and composed image matching. We propose a simpler alternative grounded in a key observation: a model's own prediction errors are natural counterfactual demonstrations that directly encode its failure modes. Our method, SMILE (Self-Mined Visual In-Context Learning from Errors), builds a model-specific pool of hard negatives offline by recording the target VLM's own mistakes. translated_title: 错误的价值：从错误中自挖掘的视觉上下文学习
translated_abstract: 视觉上下文学习（ICL）使视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够通过演示示例在测试时进行自适应，但其有效性关键取决于所选的示例。近期的反事实选择方法通过构建能够展示单个属性变化如何影响答案的演示来改进ICL，然而这类方法需要涉及属性提取、描述工程和组合图像匹配的多阶段流水线。我们基于一个关键观察提出了更简单的替代方案：模型自身的预测错误是天然的反事实演示，直接编码了其失败模式。我们的方法SMILE（Self-Mined Visual In-Context Learning from Errors，从错误中自挖掘的视觉上下文学习）通过离线记录目标VLM自身的错误，构建一个特定于该模型的困难负样本池。在测试时，预测结果作为方向信号，在语义嵌入空间中浮现出最可能……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SMILE方法，将视觉语言模型自身的预测错误作为天然的反事实演示样本，通过离线挖掘错误构建模型专属的困难负样本池，以更简单的流程改进视觉上下文学习的示例选择。
en_tdlr: SMILE leverages a VLM's own prediction errors as natural counterfactual demonstrations, mining a model-specific pool of hard negatives offline to improve visual in-context learning with a simpler pipeline than existing counterfactual selection methods.
